memory_candidates.content: When authoring a plan phase's **Tier Justification**, run suite_selection_select (via verify-touched.sh or by sourcing scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) ONCE over the phase's entire Files-to-modify set, never per path. A phase mixing a pure-markdown context file with a structured data file (e.g. an extension's index-entries.json) yields a MIXED selector output: the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel for the unmapped markdown path alongside real suite basenames for the mapped one. The honest claim in that case names the real suites and omits the sentinel entirely -- the sentinel is a claimable suite name only when it is the selector's ENTIRE output. Composing the claim from per-path runs produces a sentinel-only claim for the markdown path and a union that genuinely disagrees with the single multi-path call.
